title: feat(studio): manage datasource through the metadata-admin engine (drop bespoke page)
body:
## What
datasource is a **metadata type**, so it should be administered by the generic **metadata-admin engine** like every other type — not the hand-written `DatasourceManagerPage`/`system/datasources` route.

- **Register `datasource` as a metadata-admin resource** (`registerMetadataResource`) with a custom `ListPage` that ports the full manager: list / create / edit / delete / **test** / **sync objects**. It's a *side-effectful* type (secret encryption + connection pool + introspection), so create/edit/delete + test go through the framework `datasource-admin` REST (`/api/v1/datasources/*`), but it now lives **inside the engine**: engine route (`…/component/metadata/resource?type=datasource`), registry slot, shell. Sync creates objects via the engine's `useMetadataClient`.
- **Delete** the standalone `DatasourceManagerPage` + `system/datasources` route; repoint the System hub card + add an admin-nav "Datasources" item to the engine route.
- **Fix `MetadataRedirect`/`ObjectRedirect`**: they left a stray `system/` segment, so `system/metadata/:type` 404'd — this also repairs the existing **Object Manager** link.

## Pairs with
framework [#2091](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2091) (Setup-app "Datasources" nav entry → this engine route).

## Verification (live, browser)
Against the showcase + setup apps:
- ✅ Engine route renders the datasource manager (no bespoke page)
- ✅ **Create** `eng_demo` (sqlite) via the form → listed
- ✅ **Sync** → introspect `customers`/`orders` → **create objects** → real object metadata created (verified via `/api/v1/meta/object`)
- ✅ Setup app left menu → **Datasources** → opens this engine view
